## Design

checked: the thresholds file holds the feature switches | grep loop-check-enabled config/thresholds.json | found, a boolean
checked: no baseline doc describes a retry queue | grep -rn "retry queue" docs/baseline | no match
Precedent: none declared

Alternatives: a queue in the hub, or a queue in each lead. Recommendation: a queue in each lead.
Owner triggers found: no precedent with real alternatives.
